intro.fr: Sven Co-op se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Sven Co-op can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub barretg/hl1-sven-ap, qui héberge l'APWorld de Sven Co-op.
text.en: The GitHub repository barretg/hl1-sven-ap, home of the Sven Co-op APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.
text.en: The first version, v0.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (8 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (8 versions released).

text.fr: Sven Co-op figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Sven Co-op is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
